ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 8.0-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
method: ffmpeg select=gt(scene,0.04) at 30 fps; require one cut exactly one frame after the previous sampled score second for each visible +1 event; require two remaining cuts at set resets
limitations: A hard cut separates edited rally clips, but it does not identify serve contact or dead-ball frame inside the clip.
The match recording may omit the last point of a set; only the 122 visible +1 events are mapped.
Score reading and cut interpretation were reviewed by one analyst, not an independent observer.
The cut threshold is source-specific and must be rescanned if the video file changes.
